name: plotly
description: Use when creating interactive Python visualizations with Plotly, including pan, zoom, hover charts, dashboard figures, interactive HTML output, or 3D plots. Trigger terms include plotly, interactive chart, interactive plot, dashboard chart, hover, and plotly express. For static publication figures use matplotlib or seaborn; for visualization strategy use scientific-visualization.
